Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
Sponsor: Melson
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 02/01/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 83 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama Department of Transportation to implement and administer the Alabama Airport Economic and Infrastructure Program which would make available grants to general aviation and commercial services airports, presumably from federal funds, for the purpose of funding improvements, paying debt service for improvements and funding efforts to grow and expand commercial aviation service in the State.
Steve Livingston, Chairperson
Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development

Committee: Ways and Means General Fund
Sponsor: Melson
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 02/11/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 83 as passed the Senate would increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama Department of Transportation to implement and administer the Alabama Airport Economic and Infrastructure Program, which would grant funds to general aviation and commercial services airports for the purpose of funding improvements, paying debt service for improvements and funding efforts to grow and expand commercial aviation service in the State. This bill prohibits the total grants awarded under this program from exceeding the amount appropriated to the program, and no funding source is provided for the program in this bill.
Steve Clouse, Chair
Ways and Means General Fund

Committee: Ways and Means General Fund
Sponsor: Melson
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 02/23/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 83 as amended and reported by the Committee on Ways and Means General Fund would increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama Department of Transportation (ALDOT) to implement and administer the Alabama Airport Economic and Infrastructure Program, which would grant funds to general aviation and commercial services airports for the purpose of funding improvements, paying debt service for improvements and funding efforts to grow and expand commercial aviation service in the State. This bill prohibits the total grants awarded under this program from exceeding the amount appropriated to the program and would allow funds to be appropriated from the State General Fund to the Alabama Department of Economic and Community Affairs for the operation and management of this program through an intergovernmental agreement with ALDOT. This bill also prohibits funds earmarked to ALDOT to be used for this program.
Steve Clouse, Chair
Ways and Means General Fund
